name: AI Workspace Kit
description: Add an installed AI workspace as a host project, open a coordinator session, or hand a claimed ticket to an executor session. Returns the call plan only; it never performs host writes.
whenToUse: Use after installing the AI workspace: add the directory as a project, open a coordinator session, send the first instruction, or hand a claimed ticket to an executor. Not for editing workspace files.

bootstrap.description: Return the call plan for add-project → open coordinator session → verify session → write the local kickoff receipt; no host writes. Steps match <workspace>/onboard.py --json bootstrap: list_projects → create_project → send_to_session → list_sessions → write_receipt. The last step is local: the session itself writes <workspace>/.data/onboard-receipt.json, and write_receipt is not a cindy_helper tool. Failure paths: stop when list_projects is unreadable, never guess a path; fix the directory or reuse project_path on create_project conflicts; on NOT_FOUND / ARCHIVED / DELETED from send_to_session check list_sessions instead of creating again; if list_sessions has no matching title and workingDir, the session was not created; never invent a target_session_id for write_receipt, and stop when the file cannot be written.

dispatch_ticket.description: Return the call plan for dispatching a claimed ticket; no host writes. Steps match <workspace>/onboard.py --json dispatch_ticket: get_ticket → claim_ticket → send_to_session → list_sessions; send_to_session shares the bootstrap parameters. Failure paths: stop unless get_ticket is ready / rework; DISPATCH_BUSY means finish the in-flight ticket, SELF_DISPATCH means use another executor session, STALE_ATTEMPT means re-read the revision; on NOT_FOUND / ARCHIVED / DELETED from send_to_session repair the session first, and stop a mistakenly created task before resending with target_session_id; a missing executor session means dispatch is incomplete, never bind_session yourself.
